scope: All E01-E31 conditions specified. The evaluator, deterministic anchor and local stochastic projection have separate verification scopes.

derived_checks_by_representation.note: Reduced form uses E27 as R7, reconstructs E22 positions and checks E26. Original form imposes E22/E26 and checks E27. Never impose both clearing representations independently.

recovered_production_multipliers: For K_e>0 and R1 satisfied: lambda=max(P-MC_d,0), mu_Q=max(MC_d-P,0); substitute lambda into E13; not additional free functions.
recovered_positions: For v>0: hI=-alpha_I*I+wI*H, hD=C+wD*H, hf=wf*H; H=alpha_I*I-C; wi=(1/ai)/T.
zero_variance: Require F=mu for bounded financial choice; positions not unique; displayed shares are a continuous-limit selection only.

expectation_sources.mean_price: same P policy evaluated on Phi(s,G(s),epsilon)
expectation_sources.future_production: same Q policy and same Phi/Pi
expectation_sources.future_shadow_values: same W policies and same Phi/Pi
expectation_sources.multi_period: same policy and transition on complete paths; d_t,s retained inside expectations

candidate_innovation_kernel.degenerate_validation: B=0 deterministic limit or explicit reduced-rank kernels for interface checks only

admissibility: nonempty policy-invariant state domain almost surely
no-bubble shadow values and appropriate transversality
no clipping of invalid quantities or prices
1+i_bar+r>0 on the entire supported state domain
expected discount products decay sufficiently for full objectives, not only capacity values
investment_sufficient_convexity: If b_t <= b_max < infinity, chi > 2*omega_B*sum(b_max**(k/2) for k=1..L-1). Sufficient not necessary; omega_B retained; discount convergence is a separate requirement.

conditional_subproblem.current_discount: legacy beta argument means current b_t>0, no constant-future-rate claim

local_stochastic_projection.scope: Synthetic local policy approximation under a stationary technology path and the declared full Rademacher kernel.

state_dimension: n_x + n_id + L + R + 3; n_x=4, n_id=5 gives L+R+12
optional_value_level_check: Producer value V may be recovered and Bellman-checked; it is not an additional independent structural restriction on the minimal policy system.
time_index: Calendar t and known deterministic tau(t); not an extra stochastic state.

macro_closure.transition: block diagonal Ax/Rid and Bx/Sigmaid in E01
macro_closure.tau: known deterministic path; constant in stationary anchors
macro_closure.wealth: one-period cohorts exit; risk capital independent of old settlements

measurement_kernel.type: conditionally independent Gaussian with zero mean
measurement_kernel.independent_of: all structural innovations and initial state
measurement_kernel.observation_map: fixed H_t after units, timing, scale and available-series selection

discounting.sufficient_decay: sup_S E[d_t,t+n] <= M*rho_d**n with M finite, rho_d<1
discounting.capacity_only: rho((1-delta)*K_b)<1 is weaker and does not alone ensure the whole firm objective is finite

full_condition_evaluator.continuation_moments: internally computed from the same callback and kernel
checks: raw demand, procurement, inventory and three position FOC
